a.text: Being upfront before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first means we'd both very likely end with 0 cells. So I'm proposing a change rather than breaking our deal quietly. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If no storm hits, I'll operate every remaining round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather settle this another way, tell me and I'll consider it.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this departs from our agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves you exposed. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the reserve can build up for you to take 4 as soon as it's there.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
